props.title: Install ShowAI
props.lead: Download the ShowAI app on a Mac with Apple silicon to get started; the agent plugin and runtime come with the app. On Windows or Linux, or to contribute to development, run the browser edition from source.

facts.label: account
facts.value: No need to log in to use this machine

content.text: Install the app on a Mac
You need a Mac with Apple silicon running macOS 13 or later. The app includes its own runtime, so you don't need to install Node.js or download the source code.

steps.title: Download DMG
steps.body: Download the DMG from the [latest release](https://github.com/Renaissance-Mind/ShowAI/releases/latest) on GitHub. The release also includes a ZIP of the same app and the checksum file `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

steps.title: Drag to Applications, then open it
steps.body: Open the DMG, drag **ShowAI** into Applications, then open ShowAI from Applications.
steps.result: On first launch, ShowAI shows the welcome screen, which includes the plugin panel for connecting an agent.

steps.title: Connect your agent
steps.body: On the welcome screen or in Settings → Plugins, click Install plugin for Claude Code or Codex, then restart the agent and start a new conversation. For the full steps, see [Quick Start](doc:quick-start).

content.text: Blocked by macOS on first launch?
Current builds are not yet notarized by Apple, so macOS may block the first launch. If it does, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway (see
). Each release's notes say whether this is still needed.
The app currently supports only Macs with Apple silicon, not Intel Macs.
Other options: browser edition and source

On Windows or Linux, or to modify ShowAI itself, run the local browser edition. All three options use the same workbench and file format; you can install them side by side and share projects by pointing them to the same content library.

props.note: All options use the `~/.showai` content library by default, and content stays on your computer. Browser packages are built with `npm run package:browser` or the “Browser distributions” workflow on GitHub.

content.text: The browser edition runs on macOS, Linux and Windows. It needs Git plus
and npm. The browser version and desktop version come from the same repository and have different build commands.

steps.title: Get the source code and install dependencies
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/Renaissance-Mind/ShowAI.git
cd ShowAI
npm ci

steps.title: build
steps.note: `npm run build `will build all entrances (front-end, reader, CLI, plug-ins and desktop main process), which takes longer.

steps.title: start up
steps.note: Keep the terminal running while you use the browser edition. Closing the browser tab only closes the interface; press `Ctrl+C` to stop the service.
steps.result: The browser version prints the "ShowAI Local Workbench" address and content library path on the terminal; the desktop version opens the application window.

steps.title: Connect Agent
steps.body: The browser edition can't install the plugin from Settings in one click. Install the plugin for Codex or Claude Code from the repository; see “Install from source” in [Use with an Agent](doc:agent-hosts).

The default content library is in the user's home directory
. Below is the main structure of a content library. Click to see the role of each item.

props.caption: Content library directory structure (only common items listed).

nodes.name: .showai
nodes.detail: You can "Select Content Library" in "Settings → General → Content Library", or you can use `--home `or the environment variable `SHOWAI_HOME `to fix the location of a startup.

children.name: library.json
children.summary: Format tags for the content library.

children.name: content.sqlite
children.summary: Transactional SQLite database that holds the current content of all projects.
children.detail: Each save atomically updates the content and concurrency tokens to generate a readable file under `workspace `. The directory name follows the old version of the content library to maintain compatibility.

children.name: workspace
children.summary: Readable workspace file, generated from the database.
children.detail: These JSONs are easy to view and retrieve. Please modify the content through the workbench, CLI or Agent; directly modified files will be recognized as external modifications and need to be processed before they can continue to be saved.

children.name: project.json
children.summary: Project metadata, including folder hierarchy and pins.

children.name: pages
children.summary: Pages and whiteboards in the project.

children.name: <Page ID>.json
children.summary: The contents of a page or whiteboard.
children.detail: For the format, see [Page File Format] (https://showai.renaissancemind.ai/doc/file-format).

children.name: packages
children.summary: Component and template versions within the project.

children.name: packages
children.summary: Components and templates registered globally and available to all projects.

children.name: assets
children.summary: Resources such as images embedded in the page are stored according to content summaries.

children.name: local
children.summary: Native state: edit drafts, cache, locks, and action receipts.
children.detail: Only belongs to this device. Native drafts retained in case of conflicts are also here.

children.name: agent-runtime.json
children.summary: The registered ShowAI runtime is relied upon by the plug-in to find the executable program.
children.detail: Written when starting the workbench or running `runtime register `. After moving the distribution package or rebuilding it, start it again to refresh.

The difference between browser version and desktop version
The functionality is the same, but the browser has its own limitations:

: Importing pages, importing component source code, exporting and switching content libraries all use the file selector in the workbench. You can enter the path and create a new folder; when the exported file already exists, you will be prompted to overwrite it.
: The page is still automatically saved and is also supported

. When it has not been saved or there is a conflict, leaving the tab will pop up the browser's exit confirmation, but the browser cannot wait until the save is completed before closing. Please take a look at the save status before leaving.
: The independent page window is a new tab page in the browser; "Show page file" will open the system's file manager.
Open desktop apps at the same time

: Both can read the same project by selecting the same content directory, and the browser will receive file change notifications from the CLI and App; writing with old version content will trigger conflict processing.

steps.title: App: switch to the new version
steps.body: Download the new DMG from the [latest release](https://github.com/Renaissance-Mind/ShowAI/releases/latest) and drag ShowAI into Applications to replace the old version. Then click Update and enable in Settings → Plugins so the plugin switches to the version bundled with the new app, and restart the agent. Your content library is not inside the app, so it is unaffected.

steps.title: Source code: pull and rebuild
steps.body: After pulling, reinstall the dependencies and build, then restart the workbench.

variants.label: Browser version
variants.code:
git pull
npm ci
npm run build:browser
npm run browser

variants.label: Desktop version
variants.code:
git pull
npm ci
npm run build
npm run desktop

steps.title: Release package: replace it with a new version of the package
steps.body: Unzip the new version and launch it with its launcher. The Agent's runtime registration will be updated accordingly. The content library is not included in the distribution package and will not be affected.

steps.title: Codex plugin installed from source: refresh
steps.note: After updating, open a new Codex session and the old session will not reload the tool.

content.text: When opening a content library in the old format, "Upgrade Content Library" appears in "Settings → General": it imports existing content and enables the current storage method, and the original files are retained.
